description: Source of truth for which artwork has been confirmed and assigned. artwork/ itself is gitignored (bulk, large); this file is tracked, so it's the only durable record that an assignment happened. Check this before assigning anything new -- the same picture must never get used for two things.

assets.note: An elevated coastal highway curving toward the city skyline, dramatic cumulus cloud bank, warm evening light. The road the six spotlights of The Road In are each travelling, from a distance.

Already named by the artist -- a skeletal figure in a white coat and stethoscope, arms folded, standing in a cluttered clinic office with a wall clock and a first-aid kit. Matches the bible's doctor-founder exactly.
Companion detail shot -- his skeletal hand resting on a desk edge, warm side light. A close-up variant, not the primary portrait.

Already named by the artist -- a massive gnoll warrior, feathers and painted bands, low-angle heroic framing. Confirms the gnoll-statue connection: Hyuck himself is the gnoll. Founder, alongside Shucks Mordant and Rupiah (blank-inheritance-master-timeline.md, ~200 years ago).
Already named by the artist -- an elf-eared figure in golden window light, moths nearby, contemplative profile. The third founder alongside Hyuck and Shucks Mordant.

Already named by the artist, found under character-portraits/mitflits/ -- blue-skinned, tall-eared, wide-brimmed hat and round tinted glasses. The mitflit founder who recruited Hyuck, Shucks Mordant and Rupiah to intervene ~200 years ago (mitflits.md already names her as the founder).
